title: Stock of money and components, 1859–1866
source: Historical Statistics of the United States, Millennial Edition, Table Cj26-41 (Friedman, Schwartz and Mitchell; contributed by Hugh Rockoff). Cj26 is the stock of money excluding interest-bearing currency; Cj34 is non-interest-bearing government currency, mostly greenbacks; Cj29 is the total stock of specie at face value. From June 1861 to November 1864 the figures cover the Northern states only.
